status: Original Rx/ZZ-only decoder proposal ruled out for connected bipartite graphs without ancillas; symbolic extension audit ongoing

sources.title: Dicke-state preparation through global transverse control of Ising-coupled qubits
sources.finding: Global control with all-to-all Ising interactions prepares specified symmetric states from a symmetric initial state; this is not a coherent unary decoder.

sources.title: Global variational quantum circuits for arbitrary symmetric state preparation
sources.finding: Uses global one-axis twisting and global rotations. Reported pulse steps and approximate fidelities are not native Willow CZ depths or simultaneous-column guarantees.

sources.title: The computational power of matchgates and the XY interaction on arbitrary graphs
sources.finding: General matchgates are classically simulable on paths/cycles and computationally universal on other connected graphs. This does not imply finite-size reachability for a fixed gate subset or this isometry.

original_analysis.obstruction: If U commutes with every qubit permutation and U|x>=|D_r>, then U P|x>=P|D_r>=|D_r>=U|x>, so P|x>=|x>. Thus such U cannot turn a nonsymmetric unary basis state into a symmetric Dicke state.
original_analysis.proposal: For odd n=2m+1, controlled reversal V=R^(center bit) maps upper unary counts to global-X partners of lower unary counts. A U commuting only with global X can then cover all counts after fitting the lower half with a common phase.
original_analysis.existence: The paired input/output vectors (u_r +/- X u_r)/sqrt2 and (D_r +/- D_(n-r))/sqrt2 form orthonormal sets in equal-dimensional global-X eigenspaces. Separate unitary extensions exist, but this does not prove reachability or depth for any chosen native ansatz.
original_analysis.cost_gate: V needs m controlled swaps before routing. Native compilation and boundary cancellation must be counted before any fit.
original_analysis.distinction: Independent local controls must break permutation invariance while retaining global-X symmetry; global pulse state-preparation results do not supply this isometry.
original_analysis.path_caution: H on every site changes localX generators to localZ and nearest-neighborZZ to nearest-neighborXX, placing the path-only continuous control family within the matchgate/Gaussian setting. Audit its generated algebra before assuming enough expressivity.
original_analysis.bipartite_obstruction_independently_chec: For smaller bipartition A of sizea, T=(Y on A)(Z on B)K anticommutes with every X_i and edgeZZ Hamiltonian, hence commutes with their time evolutions. Low-column targets u0->D0,ua->Da require preserving |<ua|T u0>| in{0,1}, but |<Da|T D0>|=1/sqrt(C(n,a)). This blocks the proposed Rx/ZZ-only decoder with no extra ancillas on bipartite Willow. An XX rotation breaks this antiunitary while retaining globalX, but no sufficient gate set or depth result follows.
